residual_types.presentation: declared equivalence subobject G to quotient
residual_types.invisible: ker(product observers)/G; must vanish for joint faithfulness
residual_types.substantive: cone-valued section R=A*A-B*B=D*D; must be positive and natural, not zero

holonomy_gate: present the enumerable observer category by generators and relations; choose rooted preferred paths; compare every relation path and every non-tree generator path with the preferred path to its target
directed_warning: cutoff maps need not be invertible, so periods compare parallel directed paths rather than formal loops
cohomology_warning: if Omega_f=K_target-f_*K_source for globally assigned K, it is a formal coboundary; a nontrivial cohomology claim requires a local-only assignment or a specified coefficient system where no global K exists
apex: flat anomaly transport together with a natural positive residual section and zero invisible quotient kernel
acceptance_test: Give the rational observer category's typed generators and relations, verify all fundamental directed periods, prove naturality and positivity of R on generators, and show the observer kernel equals only declared presentation relations.
